# ANCFThinPlateRotationTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [ANCFThinPlateRotationTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/ANCFThinPlateRotationTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The rotation of ObjectANCFThinPlate and NodePointSlope12 (#2228): the frame of the slopes r_x, r_y is their
#           symmetric basis, at a node and at any mid-surface point of an element. A plate strip clamped at one edge is
#           loaded by a torque at a corner of its free edge, (1) through MarkerNodeRigid on the corner node and (2)
#           through MarkerBodyRigid on the corner of the element: both give the same static solution, as the frame of
#           the element at its corner is the frame of the node; (3) the third axis of the frame is the plate normal;
#           (4) in a dynamic run, the angular velocity of the element frame is the time derivative of its rotation
#           matrix (central differences of two stored states).
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-13
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.shells import ShellMesh
import numpy as np
from exudyn import cMath #the norm of the C++ code, the same bits on every platform

SC = exu.SystemContainer()
OVT = exu.OutputVariableType
torque = [2, 1, 0.5]

def Strip(torqueOnElement):
    """a plate strip of 2 x 1 elements, clamped at the edge x = 0, the torque at its corner (1, 0, 0)"""
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    oGround = mbs.AddObject(ObjectGround())
    plate = ShellMesh(vertices=[[0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0], [1, 0.5, 0], [0, 0.5, 0]], numberOfElementsX=2, numberOfElementsY=1,
                      youngsModulus=2e9, poissonsRatio=0.3, density=1000, thickness=0.01)
    plate.CreateANCFThinPlateElements(mbs)
    for node in plate.boundaryNodeNumbers['left']:
        mbs.CreateGenericJoint(itemNumbers=[oGround, mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodeRigid(nodeNumber=node))])
    corner = plate.vertexNodeNumbers[1]
    pCorner = mbs.GetNodeOutput(corner, OVT.Position, configuration=exu.ConfigurationType.Reference)
    #the element and its local corner at the corner node
    (element, local) = next((e, [xi, eta, 0]) for e in plate.elementNumbers for xi in [-1, 1] for eta in [-1, 1]
                            if cMath.norm(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(e, OVT.Position, localPosition=[xi, eta, 0],
                                              configuration=exu.ConfigurationType.Reference) - pCorner) < 1e-12)
    if torqueOnElement:
        marker = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyRigid(bodyNumber=element, localPosition=local))
    else:
        marker = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerNodeRigid(nodeNumber=corner))
    mbs.AddLoad(Torque(markerNumber=marker, loadVector=torque))
    mbs.Assemble()
    return (mbs, corner, element, local)

def Settings():
    simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
    simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False
    simulationSettings.staticSolver.verboseMode = 0
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
    simulationSettings.staticSolver.newton.relativeTolerance = 1e-10
    return simulationSettings

checks = []
solutions = []
for torqueOnElement in [False, True]:
    (mbs, corner, element, local) = Strip(torqueOnElement)
    mbs.SolveStatic(Settings())
    solutions += [np.array(mbs.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates())]
    if torqueOnElement:
        RNode = mbs.GetNodeOutput(corner, OVT.RotationMatrix).reshape(3, 3)
        RElement = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(element, OVT.RotationMatrix, localPosition=local).reshape(3, 3)
        slopeX = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(element, OVT.Director1, localPosition=local)
        slopeY = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(element, OVT.Director2, localPosition=local)
        normal = np.cross(slopeX, slopeY)
        normal /= cMath.norm(normal)
        tip = mbs.GetNodeOutput(corner, OVT.Displacement)
        exu.Print('corner displacement', tip)
        checks += [np.abs(RNode - RElement).max() < 1e-13, np.abs(RElement[:, 2] - normal).max() < 1e-13,
                   np.abs(RElement.T @ RElement - np.eye(3)).max() < 1e-14]
difference = np.abs(solutions[1] - solutions[0]).max()
exu.Print('torque on the element against the torque on the node: largest difference of the coordinates', difference)
checks += [difference < 1e-10*np.abs(solutions[0]).max()]

#dynamic: omega of the element frame is the time derivative of its rotation matrix
(mbs, corner, element, local) = Strip(True)
localMid = [0.3, -0.2, 0]
simulationSettings = Settings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 100
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.01
mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
R1 = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(element, OVT.RotationMatrix, localPosition=localMid).reshape(3, 3)
omega = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(element, OVT.AngularVelocity, localPosition=localMid)
q = np.array(mbs.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates())
q_t = np.array(mbs.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates_t())
epsilon = 1e-7
mbs.systemData.SetODE2Coordinates(q + epsilon*q_t)
R2 = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(element, OVT.RotationMatrix, localPosition=localMid).reshape(3, 3)
mbs.systemData.SetODE2Coordinates(q - epsilon*q_t)
R0 = mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(element, OVT.RotationMatrix, localPosition=localMid).reshape(3, 3)
mbs.systemData.SetODE2Coordinates(q)
W = (R2 - R0)/(2*epsilon) @ R1.T
omegaNumerical = np.array([W[2, 1], W[0, 2], W[1, 0]])
omegaError = cMath.norm(omega - omegaNumerical)/cMath.norm(omega)
exu.Print('angular velocity', omega, ', from the rotation matrix', omegaNumerical, ', relative difference', omegaError)
checks += [omegaError < 1e-6]

exu.Print('checks:', checks)
u = sum(checks) - len(checks) + cMath.norm(tip)
exu.Print('solution of ANCFThinPlateRotationTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
